Inside Every Box

The Vanilla trifecta

Every box is built in layers. The three sauces aren't add-ons — they're poured over the top of every box, where they penetrate the surface and dive deep, so every spoonful hits a different combination.

Layer 1 · The base
Fudge brownie crumbles

A base of fudge brownie crumbles at the bottom of every box — rich, chocolatey, and in every bite from below.

Layer 2 · The vanilla
Creamiest vanilla + crushed cookies

Our creamiest vanilla mixture poured over the base, mixed with crushed cookies just for texture — not for flavour, just for that bite.

Layer 3 · The sauces
Three homemade sauces, on top

Vanilla cashew, milk choc and dark fudge — all three poured on top of every box. They sink in and dive deep, creating infinite combinations of flavour in one box.

  • 1Vanilla Cashew Sauce — smooth and nutty, poured over the top of every box.
  • 2Milk Choc Sauce — rich milk chocolate, poured over the top of every box.
  • 3Dark Fudge Sauce — deep, dark fudge, poured over the top of every box.

No two spoonfuls taste exactly the same — that's the whole point.

Our Story

Started with tastings. Built on Karachi.

ICEBOY started the slow way: 200+ tastings, honest feedback, and recipe after recipe until it tasted the way it should. Since then it has reached 100+ people in Karachi — including a full batch made for an A-levels college campaign — and now it's ready to order, box by box, across the city.

Homemade, small-batch, no shortcuts. That's the whole idea.
